label: preparing
what: The innkeeper and local tradespeople are coordinating a Day 1 eighteen o'clock great-hall meeting with a presentation and advance room preparations. Freight was overheard seeking a private committee-preparations conversation with the innkeeper; builder is confirming attendance arrangements. The innkeeper initially sought secrecy, but the secretary disclosed the request and is knowingly helping schedule the approved meeting. The presentation's actual subject remains unknown; a forty-years-of-service celebration is possible but not established by what I observed.
